function.name: math_roots_quadratic
function.description: Calculate the roots of a quadratic equation. Unlike math_roots_cubic, which takes four separate coefficients of a cubic, this takes three separate coefficients of a quadratic.

function.name: math_roots_cubic
function.description: Calculate the roots of a cubic equation. Unlike math_roots_quadratic, which takes three separate coefficients of a quadratic, this takes four separate coefficients of a cubic.

a.description: Coefficient of the third-degree term. This is a float type value.

b.description: Coefficient of the second-degree term. This is a float type value.

c.description: Coefficient of the first-degree term. This is a float type value.

d.description: Constant term. This is a float type value.

function.name: math_roots_polynomial
function.description: Calculate the roots of a polynomial equation. Unlike math_roots_quadratic, which takes separate a, b, and c arguments, this takes a coefficient array in highest-degree-first order.

coefficients.description: Array of coefficients of the polynomial equation starting from highest degree term.

degree.description: Degree of the polynomial equation. Default 0
